rubric.title: Daily bug scoreboard measurement integrity
rubric.description: Operational measurement carrier for the approved backlog plan P-012. This does not replace or grade the unchanged R-11 acceptance contract, activate P-013, or substitute synthetic days for seven actual days.

criteria.title: Each daily producer and consumer retain a fresh complete authenticated seven-metric result
criteria.model: The registered bugs:daily-scoreboard instrument creates an immutable source and cycle receipt, then consumes exactly that cycle. A healthy reading requires all seven registry metrics from qualified append-only event history, complete populations and original clocks, independently authenticated reconciliation, exact runtime closure and schedule provenance. Baseline, missing/partial/unqualified history, unknown expected-fire provenance and failed production cannot be healthy. The operational cadence is daily UTC; R-11 and P-013 retain their independent seven-real-day and final-maturation acceptance gates.
criteria.method: Use the maintained registered platform instrument via the existing rubric-rescore action; retain each source/cycle artifact in the existing artifact store and its exact reportRef in the canonical test_runs results ledger. Grade through scorecards:emit fromLedger only after normal independent standard-rubric ratification. A new writer error supersedes an earlier pass as the current measurement; never read an old healthy cell as new proof.
criteria.driftMarkers: Wrong-cycle, stale, forged, missing-source, unqualified history, absent independent reconciliation or missing runtime/cadence proof returns unknown/error or fails; no previous successful result may hide the new error.
criteria.replication: Run maintained bug-scoreboard-instrument.test.ts and bug-inflow.integration.test.ts with npm run test:file. Unit cases distinguish every raw metric and original clock; real PostgreSQL cases retain immutable source/receipt identity across restart, reject wrong/stale/forged/missing-source packets and record a new unknown measurement after an earlier synthetic healthy control. Production source qualification and actual scheduled runtime remain separate checks.
